name: POV, Captions Only
description: Three silent shots of the thing being used, with the whole argument in the captions. Nobody speaks and no face is held across beats — this is the one shipped format built for a muted feed, where the words are read rather than heard. Choose it when the product is better looking at than listening to.

moment.description: The moment being shown, as a POV: 'you open the shop before anyone else is up'.

beats.description: 3 things the viewer sees happen, as a list of short strings. Physical actions, not feelings.

cta.description: The final caption. Short — it is read, not spoken.

value.frame: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic phone photograph, first person point of view — the viewer's own hands and forearms enter the bottom of frame. Available light only, one direction, real shadows, honest colour with no grade. Real surfaces with wear on them. Shallow but ordinary depth of field, the kind a phone gives. Slight handheld tilt, subtle grain.
value.motion: First person point of view, phone held in one hand, the other hand doing the action. Slight natural handheld movement and a small reframe. The action completes within the shot. Nobody speaks, no dialogue, no voices, no music cue. Continuous footage, no cuts.
value.negative: talking, speech, faces, portrait, looking at camera, studio lighting, cinematic teal and orange grade, drone shot, tripod smoothness, gimbal glide, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, lettering, extra fingers, warped hands, floating hands

nodes.system: You direct silent point-of-view video for vertical feeds. You describe actions and objects, never emotions, and you trust the picture. Captions are read at a glance, so they are short, specific, and never repeat what is already visible.

shots.frame_prompt: still-image prompt, first person, hands in shot
